posts.title: A bigger CPU number is always faster

slides.text: A bigger CPU number is always faster
THE TRUTH — Cores, clocks and cooling matter — a lower tier can beat a hotter, throttling higher one. The chassis that can't cool a chip is the real spec.
Share this with the person who still believes it.

posts.title: Deploy your first Docker container

slides.text:
Deploy your first Docker container
Install Docker Desktop or spin up a cloud VM
Install Docker Desktop or spin up a cloud VM
Stop it with docker stop <id> — that's containers in 5 minutes.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Deploy your first Docker container ☁️

1. Install Docker Desktop or spin up a cloud VM
2. Run: docker run -d -p 8080:80 nginx
3. Open localhost:8080
     ✓ you're live
4. See what happened: docker logs <container-id>
5. Stop it with docker stop <id>
     ✓ that's containers in 5 minutes.

Save this for the next ticket →
